description: This file defines the BankingService interface, providing method signatures for CRUD operations and monetary transactions within a banking domain, including customer and account management and transaction retrieval.

methods.name: createCustomer
methods.description: Creates a new customer with provided details, returning the saved customer including generated ID.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves customer details by ID, returning an Optional that may contain the customer.

methods.name: getCustomers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all customers.

methods.name: updateCustomer
methods.description: Updates an existing customer identified by ID with new details, with partial updates possible.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Deletes a customer identified by ID.

methods.name: createAccount
methods.description: Creates a new bank account, optionally linked to an existing customer.

methods.name: updateAccount
methods.description: Updates account metadata such as account info, but not balance.

methods.name: deposit
methods.description: Deposits a specified amount into an account, returning the new balance.

methods.name: withdraw
methods.description: Withdraws a specified amount from an account, returning the new balance. Throws an exception if insufficient funds.

methods.name: transfer
methods.description: Transfers funds atomically between two accounts, returning the source account's new balance. Throws exception on errors.

methods.name: getTransactions
methods.description: Retrieves transaction history for a specific account.

methods.name: getBalance
methods.description: Returns current balance for a specific account.

methods.name: getBalancesForCustomer
methods.description: Returns account balances for all accounts belonging to a specific customer.
